name: Sparebankstiftelsen DNB: Naturrestaurering og formidling av naturmangfoldet
summary: Norwegian foundation that funds local nature restoration (bogs, stream reopening, kelp forest, pollinator meadows), habitat mapping and clean-ups run by organisations, mainly in Eastern Norway. Small grants are rolling; larger ones have two yearly deadlines.
reporting: Grantees submit a final report on use of funds; it must be filed before applying again
